'''Prtt's Free Pit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] and [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located within [[Tunnel 329]] inside a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]]. The establishment was operated by [[Aveton Prit]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] informer, and was often used as a place at which individuals could hold discussions and make deals within a neutral, weapons-free setting. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the bar was a favored haunt of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] operative [[Nir Rinit]].<ref name="Talnar" />
